# Blink

> AI-native platform: Blink App Builder ships full-stack web and mobile apps from natural-language descriptions (database, authentication, storage, backend, and deploy included). Blink Claw runs managed OpenClaw AI agents in 60 seconds with 200+ models bundled.

Blink replaces the "editor + Supabase + Vercel + Clerk + domain registrar" stack that most AI coding tools leave you to assemble. You describe the product in English; Blink provisions real Postgres, wires authentication, writes the frontend and backend, deploys to a live URL you own, and hands you a GitHub repo from day one.

Every link below has a machine-readable markdown twin at `<url>.md` (served with `Content-Type: text/markdown`). For a structured full-content dump of the highest-value pages, fetch https://blink.new/llms-full.txt. For per-section drill-down with all URLs, see the section indexes linked below.

## Core

- [Blink — AI-native app builder and agent hosting](https://blink.new/index.md): Build full-stack web and mobile applications by describing them in English.
- [Blink pricing](https://blink.new/pricing.md): Pricing for Blink App Builder, Blink Cloud (vibe coding cloud), and Blink Claw (managed OpenClaw hosting). Live, authoritative source.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://blink.new/faq.md): Answers to the most common questions about Blink. See live FAQ at https://blink.new/faq for the most current version.

## Products

- [Blink Claw — Managed OpenClaw Hosting](https://blink.new/claw.md): Deploy OpenClaw agents in 60 seconds. No Docker, no VPS, no API key juggling. Always-on isolated VMs, 200+ AI models bundled. Agents run 24/7 in Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp.
- [Blink Cloud — the vibe coding cloud](https://blink.new/cloud.md): Production infrastructure for AI-coded apps. Use any coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) with managed database, authentication, backend runtime, hosting, queue, custom domains, and an AI gateway. One platform, one API key, one bill.
- [Blink AI Agents — Hire Your AI Workforce](https://blink.new/agents.md): Browse 13+ specialist AI agents ready to deploy in 60 seconds. Each one always-on, autonomous, and accessible directly in Slack, Telegram, or Discord. Agents run on your workspace credits via Blink Claw.
- [Gerald — Chief Financial Officer | Blink AI Agents](https://blink.new/agents/ai-cfo.md): Grows your wealth, builds bulge-bracket-grade financial models, and handles your books and taxes.

## Canonical definitions

- [What is agentic coding?](https://blink.new/what-is-agentic-coding.md): Agentic coding is using AI agents that plan and execute coding tasks autonomously, rather than line-by-line pair-programming assistants. The agent decides which files to read, what to change, and how to verify — you review the plan and the result.
- [What is OpenClaw?](https://blink.new/what-is-openclaw.md): The open-source AI agent project formerly known as Clawdbot and Moltbot. Fastest-growing agent project in GitHub history: 250,000+ stars in 60 days.
- [What is vibe coding?](https://blink.new/what-is-vibe-coding.md): Canonical definition: vibe coding is the practice of building software by describing the desired behavior in natural language and iterating on the result, rather than writing code line-by-line. Term coined by Andrej Karpathy in February 2025.
